g.desc: Inventory: three street-scene images arranged left-to-right as raw input, white-balanced image, and pseudo-sRGB image; black thin arrows and a current-estimation module connect them. The three photos are horizontally aligned; labels sit directly underneath; a downward/upward grey connector links pseudo-sRGB to the lower process.

Inventory: upper-right section contains a title, pretrained VLM rounded panel with Visual Encoder, Text Encoder, token row, LM Decoder, and output arrow to an instruction card. A grey arrow points from the instruction card back toward the Text Encoder. The section has horizontal symmetry around the VLM-to-prompt connection.

g.desc: Inventory: bottom-left section includes chromaticity-space gradient plot with b/g and r/g axes, iterative estimates connected by dashed green arrows, equations for light update, and a small RGB vector diagram. The plot and equations occupy left and upper center; the RGB diagram sits to their right; the section has no exact symmetry but follows a left-to-right explanatory partition.

Inventory: bottom-right section contains a LoRA-finetuned VLM panel on the left, a downward arrow to a large answer box labelled Blue, a grey leftward arrow from color-prior cards into the Text Encoder, multiple rounded color-prior cards on the right with colored swatches, and a prompt asking for the dominant light color. The left VLM and right cards form a two-column partition.
